purpose: Original images for explicitly fictional concept projects. No assets from the reference agencies are reused.

prompts.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create a premium creative agency portfolio image for an ORIGINAL FICTIONAL travel luggage brand named NOMARA. Wide landscape 1536x1024 image, editorial 3D product-and-digital-brand presentation, extremely photorealistic and beautifully art directed. Large open slim dark graphite laptop positioned slightly left of centre, viewed from slight front three-quarter angle on a warm limestone plinth. The laptop displays a refined original e-commerce homepage: small uppercase NOMARA wordmark in top left with tiny geometric N formed by two diagonal strokes, cream navigation strip, giant elegant headline 'Go somewhere new.' with restrained sans-serif type on the left, beautiful editorial campaign photograph of a matte olive ribbed carry-on suitcase and a small warm brown leather weekend bag on the right. A real physical matte olive hard-shell carry-on suitcase stands behind and to the right of the laptop, with a cognac luggage tag embossed NOMARA. Background warm seamless terracotta studio cyclorama with dramatic soft sunlight from left, beautiful controlled shadows, some negative space, tangible grain and product detail. Identity palette: terracotta #B75C42, deep olive #353D32, parchment #EEE8DD, warm ink #24251F. The only visible large brand name must be NOMARA. No Assembly, Apple marks, competing logos, fake ratings, prices, credibility badges, awards, or watermark. Make this a single cohesive full-bleed photograph, no collage of independent panels, no decorative framing, no outer website UI, no invented contact information.

Use case: product-mockup. Create a premium creative agency portfolio photograph for an ORIGINAL FICTIONAL contemporary furniture brand called ALDER & FORM. Wide landscape 1536x1024. Beautiful photo-real tactile brand identity flat lay and dimensional composition on a warm limestone surface with directional afternoon sun. Large warm ecru textured brand booklet angled slightly, with an ORIGINAL architectural monogram logo made from two interlocking angular A and F strokes, NOT circular petals or flower shapes, and perfectly legible elegant uppercase wordmark 'ALDER & FORM'. Beside it are a small burnt ochre business card with the same exact monogram and name in cream, an espresso-brown paper stationery folio with cream angular monogram, a warm ash wood material sample, and a restrained miniature furniture catalogue showing an elegant sculptural walnut-and-linen lounge chair. Composition feels like a carefully photographed design studio identity presentation: close framing, strong hierarchy, paper fibres, embossed and debossed details, long realistic soft edged shadows, exquisite print finish. Refined Swiss editorial typography, warm minimalism. Consistent palette ecru #EEE7D9, espresso #32271F, ochre #B78952, muted stone #B9B1A1. No Oak and Beech, no existing brand logos, no claims, no fabricated address, no watermark, no default letterhead lorem ipsum, no extra unrelated objects. One cohesive premium photograph, not a grid/collage, not a webpage screenshot.

Use case: product-mockup. The attached image is ONLY a brand identity and product reference. Generate a COMPLETELY NEW wide landscape 1536x1024 editorial campaign photograph for the fictional NOMARA travel brand. Preserve the exact NOMARA uppercase wordmark, small broken diagonal N symbol, matte olive ribbed carry-on design with four dark spinner wheels, cognac luggage tag, warm terracotta/olive/parchment art direction from the reference. New scene: a poised adult woman with natural dark hair, dressed in an elegant loose cream travel shirt and tailored warm-brown trousers, sits casually on a low sculptural terracotta bench in a beautiful Mediterranean modernist stone courtyard. She has the olive carry-on suitcase beside her and a cognac leather weekender on the bench. Sunlit pale travertine, a broad terracotta architectural wall, a little blue sky, carefully composed shadows and natural relaxed expression. Camera wide and editorial with the person on the left and products prominent in centre-right, refined luxury travel campaign, tactile and believable. Art-direct an understated small NOMARA wordmark in upper right and the small line 'Go somewhere new.' in lower left. All text perfectly spelled. No product ratings, no brand claims, no watermark, no additional logos, no Assembly. This is a concept campaign image, not a screenshot, not a laptop image, no collage.

Use case: product-mockup. Attached image is ONLY a reference for the ORIGINAL FICTIONAL furniture identity ALDER & FORM. Generate a completely NEW wide landscape 1536x1024 photorealistic luxury furniture studio interior and branding application. Preserve the exact refined uppercase spaced 'ALDER & FORM' wordmark and the exact delicate interlocking angular AF monogram seen on the book and cards, do not replace it with a flower. A beautiful modern architectural furniture showroom with pale warm plaster, a travertine display pedestal, warm walnut lounge chair upholstered in natural ecru linen, a sculptural walnut side table, and a very restrained branch arrangement. On the upper left plaster wall is an exquisitely crafted brushed dark bronze AF monogram and clearly legible small uppercase lettering 'ALDER & FORM', giving the brand a physical presence. Afternoon sunshine from high window at right, intentional architectural shadows, calm lived-in materials, elevated interior design magazine photography. Warm ecru, espresso brown and ochre accents, timeless craft. One cohesive photograph, wide composition, not a collage, not a UI mockup, no stock photo watermark, no Oak & Beech, no awards or years, no claims.

Use case: product-mockup. Use attached image ONLY as a visual identity reference for original fictional furniture concept ALDER & FORM. Generate a NEW wide landscape 1536x1024 premium brand application editorial diptych with precisely TWO equally wide panels and NO gap. Left panel: intimate photoreal close-up of a craftsman's torso and hands inspecting an elegant walnut chair joint at a calm workshop bench; cream linen shirt, espresso canvas apron embroidered with the exact delicate architectural AF monogram and small spaced uppercase 'ALDER & FORM' from the reference, believable hands and real woodworking texture, no face required. Right panel: beautifully art-directed macro still-life of a debossed tan leather maker's tag with same AF monogram attached to warm walnut joinery, an ecru paper care card with clear uppercase 'ALDER & FORM', and one fine wood shaving, on a warm limestone worktop. Natural side light, fine fibres, authentic warm wood tones, precise restrained composition, craft and material intelligence. Keep the mark consistent with the supplied angular A/F symbol, no circles or flowers. No extra text except brand name, no logos of real brands, no badges, no watermark, no phone/laptop. This is an original concept photoshoot, not a copy of another agency portfolio.
